slug: 转世成女开局攻略气运之子
content_zh:
【新书开张，欢迎彦祖、亦菲们捧场】
【脑存处......】
【变单，和众多气运之子有情绪拉扯】
夏日炎炎，蝉鸣阵阵。
林家后山，一袭玄色裙衫的方玉凝正斜倚着树干，悠闲地坐着。
裙摆之下，一双小巧的云纹绣鞋，一晃一晃。
清丽的小脸满是喜色，她面前是一块湛蓝色的虚拟屏幕。
【方玉凝】
【气运等级：青（黑、白、绿、青、蓝、紫、橙......）】
“来到这个世界快三年，终于是把气运等级拉高了不少。”
抬眸轻扫过系统面板，方玉凝修长的睫毛眨动，长舒了一口气。
遥想那喝凉水都塞牙的日子，她就忍不住浑身发颤。
气运这个东西，还是很重要的。
是的，方玉凝并非本地人，也并非是女人。
至少曾经......她还是个男孩子。
与许多前辈逍遥快活，成仙做祖不同，
从三年前来到这儿，方玉凝就一直在努力地活着。
直到遇到了林尘，她的第一位贵人。
成功触发金手指，一个平平无奇的系统。
至于系统的用法......

【告知：气运之子林尘，在演武比斗中败给林俊生，请宿主辅助林尘疗伤，帮助林尘排解心中烦恼，奖励：境界提升卡一张】
【气运之子林尘，距离宿主不足百米】
就是这样......
方玉凝只要完成有关气运之子的任务，就能获得奖励提升自己。
当然，除任务以外，通过和气运之子互动获取情绪值，然后用情绪值抽奖，亦是奖励的主要来源之一。
抬眸扫过系统给予的提示信息，方玉凝站起身来，稍作整理。
看着远处不断朝着这边跑来的人影，嘴角勾起一抹淡笑。
小肥羊来喽！
......
后山山巅处，林尘跌撞着走到一棵古树前，对着古树发疯似地挥舞着拳头。
眼中满是愤恨与不甘，他的嘴角带着淡淡的血迹，身上的衣袍破了好几处口子，模样显得格外狼狈。
“贼老天，你凭什么耍我！”
野兽一般嘶吼着，林尘手上动作不停，直打得拳锋处渗血，树干上树皮四溅。
“害，失落的天才，大难之后必有大福啊。”
树干之上，方玉凝看着下方的林尘，无奈地摇头叹息。
content_en:
[New book opening, welcome Yanzu and Yifei to join us]
【Brain storage...】
[Changing orders, getting emotionally involved with many children of luck]
The summer is hot and the cicadas are chirping.
In the back hill of Lin's house, Fang Yuning, wearing a black dress, was leaning against a tree trunk and sitting leisurely.
Under the hem of the skirt, a pair of small moiré embroidered shoes flickered.
Her pretty little face was full of joy, and in front of her was a blue virtual screen.
【Fang Yuning】
[Luck level: green (black, white, green, cyan, blue, purple, orange...)]
"It has been almost three years since I came to this world, and my luck level has finally improved a lot."
Raising her eyes and scanning the system panel, Fang Yuning blinked her slender eyelashes and let out a long sigh of relief.
She couldn't help but tremble all over as she thought back to the days when her teeth were filled with cold water.
Luck is still very important.
Yes, Fang Yuning is not a local, nor is she a woman.
At least once...she was a boy.
Unlike many predecessors who lived happily and became immortals and ancestors,
Fang Yuning has been working hard to live since she came here three years ago.
Until she met Lin Chen, her first noble person.
Successfully triggered the cheat, a mediocre system.
As for the usage of the system...
[Information: Lin Chen, the son of destiny, lost to Lin Junsheng in a martial arts competition. Please ask the host to assist Lin Chen in healing his injuries and help Lin Chen resolve his worries. Reward: a realm improvement card]
[Lin Chen, the son of luck, is less than a hundred meters away from the host]
That's it...
As long as Fang Yuning completes the tasks related to the Son of Luck, she can get rewards to improve herself.
Of course, in addition to tasks, gaining emotional value by interacting with the Son of Luck, and then using the emotional value to draw prizes is also one of the main sources of rewards.
Raising her eyes to scan the prompt information given by the system, Fang Yuning stood up and tidied up for a while.
Looking at the figures running towards this side in the distance, a faint smile appeared at the corner of his mouth.
The little fat sheep is here!
...
At the top of the back mountain, Lin Chen stumbled to an ancient tree and waved his fist at the tree like crazy.
His eyes were full of resentment and unwillingness, and there was a faint trace of blood on the corner of his mouth. His robes were torn in several places, and he looked particularly embarrassed.
"God, why are you playing tricks on me?"
Roaring like a wild beast, Lin Chen kept moving his hands until blood oozed from the edge of his fist and the bark of the tree trunk spattered.
"Harm, a lost genius. After the disaster, there must be great blessings."
On the tree trunk, Fang Yuning looked at Lin Chen below, shaking her head and sighing helplessly.
